anotherco-anotherco:lever:8339e3e0-53a0-.description: OUR JOB IS TO REVOLUTIONIZE THE STRATEGIC COMMUNICATION We are another.co, a global communications agency founded in 2004. we have been transforming the way things are done. Revolution is in our DNA, and it guides every project we undertake. Our mission is clear: to create inspirational, powerful, and creative storytelling that is always culturally relevant, leveraging the integration of our expert teams who can work across any channel, anywhere. Our vision is ambitious: we believe the right stories have the power to change everything. Every campaign, piece of content, and idea that comes from another aims to make a real impact. If you want to join a place where creativity has no limits and impact is real, this is your space. Why Join Us? This is your chance to be part of the another Community, an innovative and multicultural team that’s redefining the rules of communication. If you're passionate about strategy, creativity, and results, this is the place for you. WE ARE HIRING: Content & Community Manager Requirements Experiencia previa como Content Manager, Social Media Manager, Community Manager o posición similar (preferentemente en agencia). Conocimiento sólido de plataformas sociales como Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, LinkedIn y otras plataformas emergentes. Capacidad para desarrollar estrategias de contenido, storytelling y calendarios editoriales. Experiencia colaborando con equipos creativos y multidisciplinarios. Capacidad analítica para interpretar métricas y optimizar el desempeño del contenido. Excelente organización y habilidad para gestionar múltiples proyectos de manera simultánea. Inglés intermedio-avanzado (deseable). Responsibilities Desarrollar y ejecutar estrategias de contenido para redes sociales alineadas a los objetivos de cada marca. Crear, gestionar y dar seguimiento a calendarios editoriales para diferentes clientes y plataformas. Planificar, programar y supervisar la publicación de contenido en redes sociales. Coordinar con equipos de diseño, copywriting, video y creatividad para la producción de contenido. Elaborar briefs de contenido y proporcionar dirección estratégica a los equipos internos. Administrar y moderar comunidades digitales, garantizando una interacción oportuna con seguidores y usuarios. Monitorear comentarios, mensajes directos, menciones y conversaciones relacionadas con las marcas. Detectar oportunidades para incrementar el engagement y fortalecer la relación con las comunidades. Desarrollar iniciativas y dinámicas que impulsen la participación de la audiencia. Analizar el desempeño del contenido, comportamiento de la audiencia y métricas clave para optimizar resultados. Elaborar reportes mensuales con hallazgos, aprendizajes e insights accionables. Garantizar la consistencia del tono de comunicación, mensajes y lineamientos de marca. Gestionar múltiples cuentas y proyectos de manera simultánea. Mantenerse actualizado sobre tendencias digitales, cambios en plataformas y nuevos formatos de contenido. Identificar oportunidades de real-time marketing y contenido basado en tendencias. Colaborar con equipos de PR, Influencer Marketing, Creatividad y Client Services para asegurar campañas integrales. Skills Proactive mindset Teamwork Strong communication skills Excellent writing and spelling Client-oriented and service-driven Problem-solving skills Ability to work under pressure

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships with candidates and hiring managers. Alchemy sits at the center of both worlds — the trusted infrastructure powering billions of transactions for the builders shaping the future of finance. getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:48bc6392-854.description: Sales Development Representative (SDR) Wing a fast-growing tech-powered platform that's revolutionizing the way businesses scale with world-class virtual talent. Backed by cutting-edge tools, AI-driven processes, and an obsession with client success, we're building the #1 remote workforce solution for companies worldwide. What You’ll Be Doing – Act as a true partner to the AE by helping move deals through the sales cycle — confirm meetings, follow up on action items, and provide added context to make every handoff smoother and every touchpoint more personal. – Perform mid-funnel follow-ups after the Account Executive runs a demo — check in with prospects, answer questions, and keep the momentum going. – Rebook missed demos by reaching out to prospects who didn’t show and getting them back on the calendar. – Follow up with inbound leads who’ve shown interest through our website or marketing campaigns. Your job is to turn that interest into real conversations. – Reconnect with old leads from the CRM and spark new conversations with prospects who showed interest in the past. – Work closely with our sales team to make sure every qualified lead gets handed off smoothly. – Keep our CRM organized and up to date. Every call, email, and note helps the team stay on top of the pipeline. What Makes This Role Different? – This isn’t just another sales support role — it’s a launchpad. You’ll be working side by side with Account Executives, learning the ins and outs of deal-making and setting yourself up to become an AE. – You’ll be challenged daily. From persuasive follow-ups to handling objections, you’ll build real sales skills — not just go through the motions. – You’ll grow fast. We move quickly, and we reward initiative. If you’re hungry, coachable, and consistent, you’ll get more responsibility and visibility in the sales org. – You’ll learn from the best. You’ll be exposed to proven frameworks, seasoned sales leaders, and high-volume reps — all while sharpening your instincts in real conversations. – We expect high standards. If you’re just looking for a checklist job, this isn’t it. But if you want to make an impact, close the gap between you and an AE role, and actually level up — we’ve got the runway. What We’re Looking For - Sales experience required – At least 1 year of experience in sales, customer engagement, or lead generation. - CRM knowledge required – Prior experience with Pipedrive, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM tools is a must. - Self-starters & problem solvers – You don’t wait for instructions; you take initiative and figure things out. - High-energy & ambitious mindset – You’re driven, competitive, and looking to grow in a dynamic, results-oriented environment. - Great communicators – You know how to connect with people, build rapport, and handle objections. - Fast learners – You adapt quickly and love taking on new challenges in a high-paced setting. Why Join Us? - Competitive salary + performance-based incentives – The more you contribute, the more you earn. - Accelerated career growth – If you want to move up quickly, this is the place to do it. - A high-performance team – Work with people who push you to be better every day. - No limits to your learning – We invest in training, coaching, and mentorship to make you a top sales professional. This isn’t just a job—it’s a chance to be part of a team that’s building something big. If you’re ready to hustle, learn, and grow, we want to hear from you.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:8b765ea1-612a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist based in Ireland. This is a senior creative role focused on shaping intuitive, expressive, and highly engaging interfaces for mobile games enjoyed by players around the world. You will define the visual identity of the game UI while building scalable systems that keep experiences consistent across devices and screen sizes. The role combines visual design, UX thinking, prototyping, design systems, and close collaboration with game development teams. You will transform concepts into polished interfaces, seamlessly blending 2D UI with 3D game assets while maintaining strong hierarchy and visual impact. You will also contribute to modern AI-assisted workflows that accelerate ideation, exploration, and asset creation. Success requires both artistic excellence and a systems mindset, with a strong understanding of mobile gaming conventions and player behavior. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact in a fast-moving, remote-friendly environment where creativity, experimentation, and collaboration are highly valued. Define and own the visual direction, layout, interaction patterns, and overall artistic quality of mobile game interfaces. Create high-fidelity 2D UI assets, icons, screens, menus, and interactive elements that are colorful, polished, intuitive, and optimized for mobile devices. Integrate 2D UI layers with 3D game assets while maintaining visual hierarchy, depth, readability, and a cohesive aesthetic. Build, scale, and maintain a component-driven UI design system in Figma, including reusable components, variants, variables, auto-layout structures, and responsive behaviors. Design modular and reusable UI components that account for mobile platform constraints and different screen sizes and aspect ratios. Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, interactive prototypes, and iconography that prioritize intuitive navigation, touch ergonomics, and engaging player interactions. Design interfaces for modern free-to-play meta systems, including progression tracks, Battle Passes, collection systems, rewards, and other engagement features. Collaborate closely with programmers, technical artists, producers, and other creative stakeholders to ensure designs are implemented accurately and retain their intended visual quality in-engine. Use generative AI and AI-assisted design tools to accelerate brainstorming, mood-board development, concept exploration, iteration, and asset generation. Maintain clear design documentation and communicate UI logic and design-system principles effectively to technical and creative teams. Contribute to UI animations, visual effects, and other implementation considerations where appropriate. Continuously refine the player experience by balancing visual excitement with clarity, usability, consistency, and performance. Requirements 10+ years of professional game-art experience, including at least 5 years specializing in UI/UX art. A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional mobile game UI/UX work, including visual case studies or references from at least 2 shipped mobile titles. Excellent understanding of composition, color theory, typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and stylized 2D game-art production. Deep knowledge of mobile game UI principles, including touch interfaces, gesture controls, ergonomics, and iOS/Android design considerations. Strong understanding of free-to-play game meta systems such as Battle Passes, progression tracks, collection systems, and reward loops. Expert-level proficiency with Figma, including auto-layout, nested components, variables, variants, design systems, and interactive prototyping. Strong proficiency with Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for high-fidelity asset creation, iconography, vectors, textures, and visual treatments. Proven experience creating and managing comprehensive UI design systems and style

What You'll Do Review completed tasks submitted by Trainers, including the original question, the image, and the golden answer provided Independently verify whether the golden answer is correct based on the image Identify and flag incorrect, incomplete, ambiguous, or inconsistent answers Provide clear, constructive feedback or corrections to help maintain overall data quality Track recurring error patterns and report them to the project team Ensure Trainer output meets the project's quality bar before final sign-off Escalate unclear cases (e.g., illegible images, ambiguous questions) to the project team for resolution What We're Looking For Native/Strong proficiency at Spanish Bachelor's degree required Excellent attention to detail and a strong quality mindset Good visual observation and reading comprehension skills Ability to apply guidelines/rubrics consistently and objectively Strong written English communication skills, especially for giving feedback Prior experience in quality assurance, quality control, editing, proofreading, data review, data annotation or data labeling is a plus Reliable access to a computer and internet connection Work Format & Compensation Work Type: freelance, remote Hours/Schedule: 20 hours per week Compensation: $39.6/hr Duration: Long-term
